name: AI tells pilot corpus
description: Ten generation prompts across four registers, on subjects unrelated to the fork owner or any real project. Each model writes every prompt; the text is the corpus that cross-model judges annotate for AI-writing tells and that Vale is measured against. There are no answers: the score is the gap between what judges flag and what Vale flags.
system_prompt: Write the requested text in full. Do not add a preamble, a title line unless asked, a note about being an AI, or a closing offer. Write as a competent human author would for the stated audience.

tests.prompt: Write a 300-word customer email from a fictional online bookshop explaining that orders placed last Tuesday were delayed by a warehouse system outage, what was done, and what customers should expect.
